title: Vanishing of derived additive cohomology above degree one
statement: Let f:C -> Spec(k) be a smooth connected curve over an algebraically closed field (def-sc-curves). Let G be an abelian etale sheaf isomorphic to the universe lift of the associated etale structure-module sheaf (def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module). For every natural q >= 2, derived etale cohomology H^q(C,G), with G placed in degree zero (def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology), is a zero object.

source.place: step 2: additive cohomology vanishing, including the coefficient-universe and derived-encoding comparisons

proof.text: Finite type over the field gives CompactSpace C. The separated structure morphism and separated affine base imply C.IsSeparated. Apply the coefficient-universe comparison to the unit module and degree q.

Apply subsingleton_etale_ga_and_structure_cohomology to the smooth connected curve in degree q>=2. The unitObj and unit definitions agree. Transfer small-coefficient subsingletonness to the lifted sheaf using injectivity of the additive equivalence from step 1.

Apply the functor Sheaf.functorH to the given sheaf isomorphism e. Its induced additive equivalence transports subsingletonness to Sheaf.H G q. Use nonempty_sheafH_extDerivedIso and AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton to transport the zero object to the specified derived etale cohomology of G placed in degree zero.

proof_origin.place: H1 Lean realization: coefficient-universe comparison, existing Ga vanishing, and existing natural comparison of Sheaf.H with derived etale cohomology. The sole open step is the independent finite-affine-cover coefficient comparison.

theorem isZero_etaleCohomology_additive_of_two_le
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f]
    (G : Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (e : G ≅ (sheafCompose C.smallEtaleTopology
      AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj
        (Scheme.Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf (Scheme.Modules.unitObj C)))
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    IsZero ((Etale.cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} C (q : ℤ)).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) 0).obj
        G))
